description: Splits one input between two outputs under knob and CV control

params.text: Sets the division, -5 to +5: at either end one output carries the whole signal and the other nothing, and at 0 each carries half

inputs.text: The signal divided between the two outputs
Added to the PAN knob, the sum clamped to -5V and 5V

outputs.text: Carries the input scaled by the pan setting, nothing at -5 rising to the whole signal at +5
Carries the input scaled by the pan setting, the whole signal at -5 falling to nothing at +5
